story.title: Why frontier Anthropic models are performing worse on strict tool calling schemas
story.summary: Newer models like Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 are failing on nested tool arguments by emitting made-up keys. This degradation occurs because their post-training optimizes for Claude Code's highly forgiving client, which silently repairs malformed calls.
story.why: You must design simpler, flatter schemas or implement lenient parsers in your agent frameworks to prevent unexpected model-side tool failures.
